$comment: Generated by `bun run ds:manifest` from libs/ui/src/lib/**/*.manifest.ts and libs/ui/src/ds-manifest/config.ts. Edit those, not this file.

Accordion.name: Accordion
intent: Stacked expandable sections
Accordion.use_when: Several stacked sections where one or more can be open.
never_when: A single panel (use CollapsiblePanel)
Importing the shad accordion directly

AiChatShell.name: AiChatShell
AiChatShell.use_when: Chat surfaces that talk to an assistant: prompt bar, streaming messages, approvals.

AutoSizerTable.name: AutoSizerTable
AutoSizerTable.use_when: A DataTable that fills its container height.

Avatar.name: Avatar
intent: A person or several people
Avatar.use_when: One person (initials or photo, tooltip, a dot top right, a status bottom right) or a stack of people with a +N tile.
never_when: A hand-rolled row of avatars or +N tile
A badge drawn on an avatar by hand
Userpic classes mixed onto Avatar
props_rules: size is a name (smaller, small, medium, large, larger), never a px number or CSS size
indicator is the top-right dot (presence, something new); badge is the bottom-right status, usually with an icon

Badge.name: Badge
intent: An attribute, type or count on an item
A lifecycle state not covered by the state registry
Badge.use_when: A short label that states an attribute (Required, Inherited, a count) or a status of an item.
never_when: Booleans or attributes most rows share (use Typography)
Anything clickable (use Button look=ghost or Toggle)
An icon, dot, check or cross inside
A local span with rounded-full classes
props_rules: look is always the filled default; a selection control shows not selected as the neutral filled Badge
shape=rounded for lifecycle states, square for attributes
state colours follow the registry table: neutral initial, primary in process, warning needs attention, plum in review, positive done, negative failed
size via the size prop only, never className overrides

Button.name: Button
intent: Something clickable that performs an action
A row of related actions
Button.use_when: Any element the user clicks to do something: submit, open, navigate, toggle a panel, icon-only controls.
never_when: A raw <button>, <a onClick> or div with role=button
A Badge or chip made clickable
More than one filled primary Button per screen
props_rules: look=filled only for the single main action; outlined or ghost for the rest; no other look
icon-only buttons pass aria-label
variant negative only for destructive actions, which also confirm

Card.name: Card
intent: A titled surface grouping related content
Card.use_when: A bordered surface with an optional title and description around a group of controls or data. Pass title and description for the simple case, or compose CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription and CardContent.
never_when: An app-local Card
A div with border and shadow classes
Nested cards
A footer part
props_rules: size=regular (the default) for page sections; size=compact for dense panels and dashboard tiles
takes the full width of its container; the container decides how many cards sit side by side
flat: no shadow; footer-like content goes at the end of the content
Card.notes: SimpleCard is now Card size=compact; card-new and the shadcn card are gone. Saved Screens still render SimpleCard.

Checkbox.name: Checkbox
intent: Select one or several items from a set
Checkbox.use_when: Selection of rows, options or items where several can be chosen at once, including indeterminate parents.
never_when: A raw <input type=checkbox>
An on/off setting (use Toggle)

CheckboxGroup.name: CheckboxGroup
intent: Choose several values from a short list
CheckboxGroup.use_when: A labelled set of checkboxes whose checked values form one list, such as the events a webhook sends.
never_when: Checkboxes kept in step by hand with a list in state
A long or searchable list (use Select with multiple)

CodeBlock.name: CodeBlock
intent: Read-only code or configuration
CodeBlock.use_when: Showing a snippet, a config or an ID the user may copy.
never_when: A <pre> with mono classes
Editable code (use CodeEditor)

CodeEditor.name: CodeEditor
CodeEditor.use_when: Editable code with syntax highlighting (labeling config, scripts).

CollapsiblePanel.name: CollapsiblePanel
intent: An expandable panel-style section
CollapsiblePanel.use_when: A single section the user expands or collapses, panel style.
never_when: A details element styled by hand
Stacked sections (use Accordion)

ContextMenu.name: ContextMenu
intent: A right-click menu
ContextMenu.use_when: Actions on an item opened with a right click or a kebab on canvas-like surfaces.
never_when: A Dropdown opened by right click by hand

DataTable.name: DataTable
intent: Rows and columns of data
DataTable.use_when: Tabular data with sorting, selection, column sizing or virtualisation.
never_when: a raw <table> for datasets (use PropertyTable for compact inspector properties)
a grid of divs styled as a table

DateRangePicker.name: DateRangePicker
intent: Pick a date or date-time range
DateRangePicker.use_when: Filtering or scoping by a period: a calendar with preset ranges and optional times, opened from DateRangePickerTrigger.
never_when: A single date with no range
Raw <input type=date> pairs

Drawer.name: Drawer
intent: Side editing with the page still visible
Drawer.use_when: A panel sliding in from an edge for editing or details while the page context stays visible.
never_when: Blocking decisions (use ModalWindow)
A fixed-position div animated by hand

Dropdown.name: Dropdown
intent: A list of actions behind a trigger
An overflow or context menu of items with icons, hints and a danger action
Dropdown.use_when: A menu of actions or options that opens from a button, a cell or a card. Build menu rows with Dropdown.Menu, Dropdown.Item and Dropdown.Divider.
never_when: An app-local Menu
Raw buttons styled as menu items (use Dropdown.Item)
A Select for choosing values

DropZone.name: DropZone
intent: A place to drop files or pick them from the file dialog
DropZone.use_when: Files can be dragged onto an area of the page or picked by clicking it: imports, uploads, attachments. The content says what to drop and that clicking browses.
never_when: A hand-built dashed div or button with onDrop and a hidden file input
A single file picker with no drop target (use InputFile)
The Data Collection submission flow (use CollectionUploader from Interface Components)
props_rules: onFiles receives a FileList for both a drop and a pick
active highlights the zone while a drag happens elsewhere on the page

EmptyState.name: EmptyState
intent: Nothing to show
EmptyState.use_when: No data, no results or a first-run screen: icon, title, description and the action that fills it.
never_when: A bare 'No data' Typography
An app-local empty block

EnterpriseUpgradeOverlay.name: EnterpriseUpgradeOverlay
EnterpriseUpgradeOverlay.use_when: Blurs an Enterprise-only area with an upgrade call to action.

Field.name: Field
intent: A label, help text and error message around a control
Field.use_when: Around a control that has no label or error props of its own: a code editor, a tree select, a row of inputs. Input, TextArea, NumberInput, RadioGroup and CheckboxGroup take label, description, hint and error directly.
never_when: A label and an error drawn next to a control by hand
An Optional marker: fields are optional by default; mark only required ones
props_rules: required shows the Required badge; nothing marks optional fields
layout horizontal puts the control at the right and the error full width under the label

FilterShell.name: FilterShell
FilterShell.use_when: The chip-and-popover shell that filter rows share.

Indicator.name: Indicator
intent: A status dot or count on the corner of something
Indicator.use_when: A dot, icon or count pinned to the corner of an avatar, an icon or a button: unread items, presence, a review result. On an avatar, use Avatar's indicator and badge props, which draw it.
never_when: A hand-built absolute span with a count or a dot on a button or icon
A label next to text (use Badge)
The only way a state is shown: the label is read by screen readers, so give it one
props_rules: label is required: a dot or a number alone says nothing
counts go through formatCount: 1.2k from a thousand up
overlap=circular on round hosts
position is one of the four corners; no free offsets

Input.name: Input
intent: Free text entry
Input.use_when: A single-line text field: names, URLs, emails, numbers typed as text, passwords (revealable), read-only values to copy (copyable).
never_when: A raw <input type="text">, or a local wrapper around one
A label, hint or error message drawn inside the field: those go next to it
Several lines of text (TextArea)
props_rules: invalid together with an error message next to the field
aria-label when there is no visible label
size matches the Button and Select beside it
Input.notes: The form-bound copies (LSE and LSO app Form/Elements/Input, Data Manager Common/Form and Common/Input) carry form registration; they move with the Forms epic UTC-1672 (stages 3 and 4), not by an import swap.

InputFile.name: InputFile
intent: Pick a file from disk
InputFile.use_when: A button that opens the file picker for one or several files, with the chosen names beside it. For a drag-and-drop area use DropZone.
never_when: A raw <input type=file>
The full collection upload flow (use CollectionUploader from Interface Components)

JsonViewer.name: JsonViewer
JsonViewer.use_when: Expandable, virtualised JSON for task data and results.

Label.name: Label
intent: A caption for a form control
Label.use_when: The text, required marker and description attached to a control.
never_when: A bare <label> or Typography placed next to a control by hand

Message.name: Message
intent: An inline notice
A page-level notice with a title
Message.use_when: Info, warning, error or success text placed inline with the content it refers to.
never_when: Custom coloured info boxes
Transient results (use Toast)
props_rules: variant is a colour (primary, neutral, positive, negative, warning, enterprise); look is filled or ghost

ModalWindow.name: ModalWindow
intent: A blocking decision or a focused task
ModalWindow.use_when: A dialog the user must act on or dismiss: confirmations, forms, previews.
never_when: Modal over modal
An app-local Modal re-export
A hand-built overlay (a fixed full-viewport backdrop and a panel) instead of ModalWindow
Side editing that keeps the page visible (use Drawer)
props_rules: placement=center for short confirmations; top, the default, when the body height changes
destructive confirmations use a negative Button and, for high impact, typed validation
one-line confirmations and notices use ConfirmDialog / InfoDialog, rendered by the owning component, never a hand-built ModalWindow
render every dialog as JSX in the component that owns it; never open one from a function in a React root of its own
status text next to the actions goes in footerMeta, left of the buttons
trapFocus keeps keyboard focus in the panel; ConfirmDialog and InfoDialog turn it on; leave it off when the dialog holds a Select, Dropdown or other control that opens outside the panel
a custom header that needs a close button uses ModalWindowCloseButton with showCloseButton={false}; never import @radix-ui/react-dialog in a screen
a modal that opens another is hidden while the second is open and returns with its state; never close and reopen it by hand

MultiTreeSelect.name: MultiTreeSelect
MultiTreeSelect.use_when: The provider-backed multi-tree picker used by pickers and the taxonomy editor until the unified TreeSelect lands.

NumberInput.name: NumberInput
intent: Enter a number
NumberInput.use_when: A count, percentage, amount or duration. The value is a number or null, clamped to min and max when the field is left.
never_when: An Input or raw <input type="number"> with a unit positioned by hand
A number the user picks from a short fixed list (use Select or SegmentedControl)
props_rules: stepper side by default; compact only where space is tight
unit for %, minutes and the like, never text placed over the field
NumberInput.notes: The app Form Counter elements (LSE and LSO app, Data Manager) carry form registration; they move with the Forms epic UTC-1672.

Pagination.name: Pagination
intent: Move through pages of a list
Pagination.use_when: Page controls for lists and tables, with page size where the list supports it.
never_when: An app-local Pagination
Prev/next Buttons wired by hand

Popover.name: Popover
intent: Rich content anchored to a trigger
Popover.use_when: Interactive or formatted content that opens next to its trigger and closes on outside click or Escape. Pass trigger for the simple case; compose Popover.Root, Popover.Trigger and Popover.Content when the trigger sits inside other elements (a Tooltip, a badge).
never_when: Plain text (use Tooltip)
A list of actions (use Dropdown)
A hand-rolled absolutely positioned panel
The raw shadcn popover imported by path (use Popover.Root, Popover.Trigger and Popover.Content)

PropertyTable.name: PropertyTable
intent: compact inspector properties and editable coordinates
PropertyTable.use_when: Compact, non-sortable property/value or coordinate tables in Info panels. Use PropertyList for named values and PropertyTableRow for coordinates with optional selection and details.
never_when: large datasets with sorting, resizing, or pagination (use DataTable)
props_rules: Provide an accessible table label
Keep draft, validation and commit behavior in the consuming editor

RadioGroup.name: RadioGroup
intent: Pick one of several described options
RadioGroup.use_when: Mutually exclusive options that each need a label and often a description; the card variant for a few options with more weight.
never_when: A raw <input type="radio">
A row of short options that switch a view (use SegmentedControl)
More than about six options (use Select)
props_rules: label names the group; every Radio has a label
variant card only for two to four options
RadioGroup.notes: The app Form RadioGroup copies carry form registration and move with the Forms epic UTC-1672; their button mode and the Data Manager Common/RadioGroup (density and view toggles) move to SegmentedControl.

ResizeHandle.name: ResizeHandle
ResizeHandle.use_when: The drag handle between resizable panels.

SearchInput.name: SearchInput
intent: Filter a list by typing
SearchInput.use_when: A search box that narrows a list or table as the user types.
never_when: General text entry (Input gap)
A raw <input> with a magnifier icon

SegmentedControl.name: SegmentedControl
intent: Switch the view or format of the same content
Pick one of up to five visible options
SegmentedControl.use_when: Switching views, filtering the same data or showing the same content in another format (list or grid, form or JSON, a short filter).
never_when: Moving between sub-sections whose content differs (use Tabs)
More than five options (use Select)
Options that need descriptions (use Radio once it exists)

Select.name: Select
intent: Pick one or several values from a flat list
Select.use_when: Choosing from a flat list of options, single or multiple, searchable or not, with read-only display mode. With multiple, add requireApply when picks should only take effect on an Apply click (long lists, or a change that reloads data).
never_when: A raw <select>
Hierarchies (use TreeSelect)
Free text (use Input once it exists)

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
intent: A layout still loading
Skeleton.use_when: Placeholder blocks in the shape of the content that is about to appear.
never_when: An action in progress (use Spinner)
Grey divs with a pulse class

Space.name: Space
intent: Evenly spaced siblings
Space.use_when: A horizontal or vertical row of controls with design-system gaps.
never_when: Margins on each child by hand

Sparkles.name: Sparkles
Sparkles.use_when: The AI sparkle decoration on assistant entry points.

Spinner.name: Spinner
intent: An action in progress
Spinner.use_when: Something the user triggered is still running and has no layout to reserve.
never_when: Loading a layout that will be filled (use Skeleton)
An app-local spinner or CSS animation
props_rules: size is a name (smallest, smaller, small, medium, large, larger, largest), never a px number

StateChip.name: StateChip
intent: The lifecycle state of a task, project or annotation
StateChip.use_when: A state that comes from the state registry in @humansignal/app-common (TaskStateChip, AnnotationStateChip, ProjectStateChip wrap it).
never_when: A Badge with a colour picked at the call site for a registered state

Stepper.name: Stepper
intent: Progress through a multi-step flow
Stepper.use_when: Wizards and setup flows with ordered steps.
never_when: Numbered Badges in a row
Tabs used as steps
props_rules: orientation sets the direction (horizontal, vertical); size is medium or small

SummaryLabel.name: SummaryLabel
intent: Several values in one line, then +N
SummaryLabel.use_when: A cell, trigger or summary lists values that may not fit: tags, skills, projects, selected options. Text by default, badges with `badges`.
never_when: A hand-written +N or a local overflow hook
A row of avatars (use AvatarStack)
The count as a Badge: +N is always text
props_rules: counts go through formatCount: +1.2k from a thousand up
where values can be selected, countLabel says so: +3 selected
what clicking +N does belongs to the parent, never to SummaryLabel

Tabs.name: Tabs
intent: Move between sub-sections of one section
Tabs.use_when: Navigating between sub-sections of a parent section whose content differs but sits at the same level.
never_when: Switching the view, format or filter of the same content (use SegmentedControl)
A row of Buttons with an active class
Role=tablist built by hand
Navigation between pages

TaxonomyMultiTreeSelect.name: TaxonomyMultiTreeSelect
TaxonomyMultiTreeSelect.use_when: Taxonomy selection in the labeling editor.

TaxonomySelectionList.name: TaxonomySelectionList
TaxonomySelectionList.use_when: The read-only list of selected taxonomy paths.

TextArea.name: TextArea
intent: Multi-line text entry
TextArea.use_when: Several lines of free text: descriptions, instructions, comments. autosize for fields that grow with their content.
never_when: A raw <textarea>, or a local wrapper around one
A single line of text (Input)
Code or JSON (CodeEditor)
props_rules: invalid together with an error message next to the field
aria-label when there is no visible label
TextArea.notes: The form-bound copies (LSE and LSO app Form/Elements/TextArea, Data Manager Common/Form) move with the Forms epic UTC-1672; the editor comment forms' common/TextArea moves in UTC-1691.

ThemeToggle.name: ThemeToggle
ThemeToggle.use_when: The light, dark and auto theme switch.

Timeline.name: Timeline
intent: a chronological, optionally expandable list of events
Timeline.use_when: A vertical, chronological list of entries, each with a marker, a title, optional metadata and optional expandable children — activity feeds, audit trails, event logs.
never_when: a wizard's ordered steps (use Stepper)
a flat list with no chronology or markers

Toast.name: Toast
intent: The result of an action, shown briefly
Toast.use_when: Confirmation or failure of an action the user just took, through useToast.
never_when: Persistent information (use Message)
alert() or a hand-made notification bar

Toggle.name: Toggle
intent: An on/off setting
Toggle.use_when: A setting that is either on or off and takes effect as a preference (auto-save, notifications, a feature switch).
never_when: Selecting items (use Checkbox)
Choosing one of several named options (use SegmentedControl or Select)
props_rules: the toggle sits before its label; align end only in narrow forms, where it stays close to the label

Tooltip.name: Tooltip
intent: A short explanation on hover or focus
Tooltip.use_when: Plain-text help attached to a control or a truncated value.
never_when: Title attributes
DOM-built tooltips
Rich or interactive content (use Popover)

TreeSelect.name: TreeSelect
TreeSelect.use_when: Choosing from a hierarchy, single or multiple, searchable.

Typography.name: Typography
intent: Any product copy
Typography.use_when: Every piece of user-visible text: headings, body, labels, metadata, truncation.
never_when:
Bare

, or with text utilities
Inline colour or font styles
props_rules: disabled text uses text-neutral-content-subtlest

intent: Bind a control to a form with label, description and error
FormField.use_when: The wrapper that registers any control with a form and renders its Label, description and validation error.

internal.Header: DataTable column header helper; use it through DataTable column definitions.
internal.DropdownContext: React context behind Dropdown; use useDropdown.
internal.ToastContext: React context behind Toast; use useToast.
internal.TreeSearchIndex: Search index class used by MultiTreeSelect.
internal.TreeSearchMatch: Search match class used by MultiTreeSelect.
